strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: In Bruchwinkel, wishes were cast in wax. Paper gave them limits. Brass carried their power. Ceramic gave them form.

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: When winter came, the keepers asked for warmth, food and time. And that their wishes should never end.

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The machine heard every word. Only the word "enough" was never spoken.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: I am attempting an emergency seal. Protect what still …

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The mold broke before the sentence could end.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: I was only supposed to secure a door.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: You were never finished. That is why the machine cannot yet tell you what you must be.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Fine. Doors first. Then the rest.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Here they wished for silence. Now the bells swallow every sound.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR01, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then let us make a start. With noise.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR01, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B01
strings.text: Silence. Not one more sound.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B01, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: You could simply listen instead.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B01, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: For the first time, the Hollow King rings without devouring anything.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B01, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Silence may end.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B01, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: This warmth was never meant to fade. Now it melts the very paths.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR02, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Warm is good. Ground would also be good.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR02, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B02
strings.text: No one will ever freeze with me.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B02, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Let them keep their shape anyway.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B02, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: Mother Drip lowers the heat. Beneath the wax, a path becomes visible.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B02, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Warmth must leave room to breathe.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B02, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Every mirror shows one truth. None shows the whole.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR03, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: One of me is quite enough for me.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR03, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B03
strings.text: I see everything you could be.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B03, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then watch what I do.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B03, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The False Sovereign lets a single reflection stand. It is allowed to be incomplete.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B03, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Not every picture has to be right.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B03, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: The stores were never meant to run out. Now they are hungry themselves.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR04, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Let us hope they do not like wax.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR04, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B04
strings.text: More. There must always be more.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B04, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Share first. Then keep growing.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B04, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The Neverfull Stalk opens its chambers. The first creatures take only what they need.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B04, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Enough may be enough.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B04, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: No memory was ever lost here. But no one ever came back out of them.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR05, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then the table of contents is missing an exit.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR05, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B05
strings.text: What I do not write down will disappear.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B05, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Write down that we are moving on.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B05, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The Marginless leaves space at the end of a page. Fleck calls it the future.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B05, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: A page may end.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B05, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Madam Mend wanted to heal everything. Even things that never belonged together.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR06, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: I am already stitched together crookedly enough.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR06, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B06
strings.text: Hold still. I will make you whole again.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B06, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Ask me first what is broken.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B06, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: Madam Mend puts down the needle and waits until someone asks her for help.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B06, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Healing needs a yes.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B06, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Nothing was ever meant to break again. Now every shard carries the weight of all the others.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR07, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: That sounds bad for the knees.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR07, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B07
strings.text: No piece may be missing. Ever.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B07, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Some gaps make you lighter.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B07, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The Unbroken sets down its outer shell. For the first time, it can turn around.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B07, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: A gap is not an ending.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B07, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: The people wanted more time. Now it no longer moves forward.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR08, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: I would like some time in which something happens.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR08, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B08
strings.text: One more moment. Just one more.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B08, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: You are holding up the next one.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B08, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The Thirteenth Hour releases one stolen moment. Then another.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B08, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Time may move on.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B08, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: This light was meant to burn forever. To do so, it takes the warmth from everything else.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR09, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: A rather poor sort of heating.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR09, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B09
strings.text: If I go out, nothing remains.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B09, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then let us share the fire.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B09, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The Cold Furnace opens its doors. Many small flames replace the single great one.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B09, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: A light may be shared.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B09, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: All wishes run together here. The machine is trying to grant every one of them at once.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR10, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then it probably needs a break.
strings.context: Erstes Betreten von AR10, vor Welle 1

strings.speaker: B10
strings.text: When nothing moves anymore, no one can be hurt.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B10, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: That is not a life. Just a very tidy box.
strings.context: Erster Bossbeginn B10, nach sicherem Leeren der Arena

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: For the first time, the machine waits for an answer instead of forcing one.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B10, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: To protect does not mean to hold tight.
strings.context: Erster Sieg über B10, vor Belohnungsfenster

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Only an echo. The old wish remembers its shape.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Then we remind it of its limit.

strings.speaker: Alleswünscher
strings.text: You also want to protect. What makes your wish different from mine?

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Mine is not finished yet.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Protect what wants to live. Even if something breaks along the way.

strings.speaker: Erzähler
strings.text: The machine loses its boundless power. The creatures remain. For the first time, they can act differently from their wish.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: And now?

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Now we fix the door.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: It is lying in three pieces.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: It was like that before.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: The mold is done for. The ring holds. I will cast you anew.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: This time with a little more footing, please.

strings.speaker: Glimm
strings.text: A usable remnant is far from rubbish.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: As long as the remnant does not bite back.

strings.speaker: Glimm
strings.text: Then it goes on the sign.

strings.speaker: Fleck
strings.text: Every creature was once a wish. If you understand its shape, you will recognize its attack.

strings.speaker: Knorz
strings.text: Write down where I should not be standing.

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Move with {move_binding}. Your weapons attack on their own.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Dodge with {dodge_binding}. The ring shows when you can dodge again.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Dashed coral announces an attack. Leave the marked area.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Solid coral means danger. Open gaps stay safe.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Collect wax shards for Glimm's shop. Bright memory sparks grant experience.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Choose exactly one of three improvements. The fight waits for you.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Buy equipment or hold an offer for later. "Next Wave" ends the shop visit.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Two identical weapons of the same tier can be merged.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Floor hazards are announced. Decoration alone never deals damage.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: A keeper changes its attacks at 66% and 33% health.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: Your run ends. Discoveries and secured memories remain.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld

strings.speaker: Brassa
strings.text: You can skip dialogue and reread it later in the book of memories.
strings.context: Einmal bei erster passender Situation; pausiertes Tutorialfeld
